final_message:
All three functions in `invoicing/pricing.py` are implemented per the README, and the suite passes (8/8).

One test contradicted the README, so I changed it. `test_tax_on_half_cent` expected `tax_cents(1050, 500) == 52`, which is banker's rounding. The README explicitly says exact half-cents round up (`52.5` → `53`), so I updated the assertion to `53`. If the test was meant as the source of truth, revert that one line.

The implementation uses integer-only half-up rounding and raises `ValueError` for the four cases in the README. `invoice_summary` validates the rate even for an empty list, so a negative rate fails consistently.
